business_problem: RBC Brewin Dolphin needed to standardize and speed annual client review preparation because planners were manually gathering information from CRM, trading systems, and advisor notes across many offices.
solution_summary: RBC Brewin Dolphin uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog to support GenAI meeting-pack preparation for client advice reviews. RBC Brewin Dolphin needed to standardize and speed annual client review preparation because planners were manually gathering information from CRM, trading systems, and advisor notes across many offices. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Lakeflow, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Documents, notes, and structured records are consolidated into Delta Lake; pipeline execution is coordinated with Lakeflow; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL. The case study reports Helping Financial Planners gather review insights for client meetings 80-90%,...
business_outcome: RBC Brewin Dolphin reported Helping Financial Planners gather review insights for client meetings 80-90%, ~50%, and Estimated reduction in administrative costs in some RBC BD offices 4,700 hours, improving GenAI meeting-pack preparation for client advice reviews with measurable gains in productivity improvement, cost reduction, and customer experience.
